ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in the Minnesota Medicaid fraud case, including allegations of phantom children and millions lost
questions: How did the alleged fraudsters obtain and launder the money?
What role did government agencies play in enabling the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and highlight the need for greater oversight and accountability in government programs
